# Query-anchored fusion — synthetic

Test split, the cells of the audit's runs. RMSE in physical units; J = RMSE / RMSE of a zero-anomaly prediction in train-normalized anomaly units (lower is better); copy = J for TEMP when the queries are input profiles of the unseen test months. Mean ± sd over seeds.

These are development reconstruction results, not independent confirmation or causal forecasts. Monthly and daily satellite configurations use different information. Seed counts are shown explicitly.
